name: Happy Go Lucky - Yellow Rose
description:
Classic fragrant on sturdy climbing canes. A grandiflora with the old-fashioned good looks of an English garden rose. Excellent disease resistance and minimal upkeep requirements. Plants have large, glossy, medium green leaves and grow 3–5' tall. 
 This plant is patented and i am working to see if they let grownwithpurpose resell. 
 Stay tuned.
Symbolism & Meanings: Yellow roses are often associated with friendship, warmth, and joy.
What you get for your money: A healthy potted 5 gallon plant. As we are approaching winter, its trimmed - cut unnecessary branches - made it smaller, so it can focus on root development.

marketReference.text: As this is patented, you wont find this in stores in big box retailers like HomeDepot. Online specialist retailers like Breck's sell it for around $80 for a bare root plant. Prices and availability may change.

Care: Full sun, deep watering 1-2 times weekly, rich composted organic soil

name: Pink Ceceille Brunner Rose Vine
description: Classic fragrant, soft blush-pink blooms on sturdy climbing canes. Small, delicately pointed buds open to fragrant, light pink, double blooms in large sprays. An ever popular climber for a trellis or arbor in cottage or country gardens. Deciduous. Heaviest frangrant blooms in spring; scattered rebloom to fall
Symbolism & Meanings: Represents purity, innocence, remembrance, and sympathy.
What you get for your money: A healthy potted 25 gallon plant. The pot is about 35 inches across. It has been thoughtfully trimmed and mulched to help develop a healthy root system for the upcoming season. That is why it does not have flowers today.

marketReference.text: A similar climbing rose in a 6-inch pot is listed for around $80. Prices and availability may change.

Care: Full sun, deep watering 1-2 times weekly, rich composted soil. Keep on clipping flowers to produce more and more blooms during blooming season. If you prune all the excess growth and keep only the main canes in winter, the vine will profusley bloom next season. Thats a gift that will never stop giving
